newsitem.title: UK: Triplex raises bid for William Cook.
newsitem.headline: Triplex raises bid for William Cook.

text.p: British engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc said on Tuesday it had raised its bid for William Cook Plc to 400.7p per share, valuing the steel products group's issued ordinary share capital at around 74.8 million stg.
Triplex said its increased offer was final and would be made on the basis of 21 new Triplex shares and 3,740 pence in cash for every 20 William Cook shares.
Triplex, which launched its bid in November, was previously offering seven of its own shares and 1350 pence cash for every nine William Cook shares.

Triplex said William Cook shareholders would also be offered a fully underwritten cash alternative of 383.4 pence per share. Also a share election and loan note alternative would be offered, the company said.
Triplex's previous offer valued William Cook at just under 58 million pounds and was worth around 309p per share.
Triplex said it believed the planned acquisition could generate at least 2.5 million pounds of additional operating profit annually because of incremental sales and cost savings.
Triplex said the similarities between the two companies' casting activities would enable Triplex to carry out a rapid integration on a low-risk basis. It said their customer bases were complementary.
